newsitem.title: NORWAY: Statoil restarts Gullfaks C output.
newsitem.headline: Statoil restarts Gullfaks C output.

text.p: Den norske stats oljeselskap AS (Statoil) said on Monday it had restarted oil production at the North Sea Gullfaks C platform.
The entire Gullfaks development, together with Saga Petroleum's Tordis development, which feeds through crude to Gullfaks C for processing, was shutdown for scheduled maintenance on October 11.
"Gullfaks C was restarted late on Sunday. Production should be back to normal by now," said Statoil spokesman Odd Jan Lange.
Gullfaks A resumed operations last Thursday, while Gullfaks B restarted on Friday. On Sunday Gullfaks A flowed at about 114,000 barrels per day (bpd) and Gullfaks B pumped almost 124,000 bpd.
Startup of Gullfaks C, which produces an average 194,000 bpd, was delayed by a day or so due to increased work during the maintenance, Lange said.
The 80,000 bpd Tordis field was expected to resume output later on Monday, he added.
